astronaut.definition: A person trained to fly into space. Astronauts wear a spacesuit because there is no air out there.
astronaut.example: The astronaut opened the hatch and stepped out.

intelill_discriminability.definition: The power of a test to separate the people who know the material from those who do not.
intelill_discriminability.example: A test that everybody passes has poor discriminability.

presence.definition: Being physically there and paying attention, as distinct from being logged in or present in name only.
presence.example: He was there, but his presence was somewhere else.

quarrel.definition: When two friends get angry with each other. Every friendship has these.
quarrel.example: We had a quarrel and made up the same afternoon.

war_strategy.definition: The way a conflict is linked to its political purpose: what is wanted, with what means, over what time.
war_strategy.example: The strategy of the campaign was to hold the coast and wait.
